title: Study options – University of Auckland
text:
Mānawa Mai Open Day | Sat 29 August
Get a taste of your future. From lectures and giveaways to DJs, food trucks and more – our campus is open for you to explore.
Find out more
Undergraduate study options
Ready to start your first university degree? Start your journey towards a brighter future by choosing to study at New Zealand's leading university.
Explore
Postgraduate study options
Whether you want to develop your skills, change careers or engage in research, a postgraduate qualification from the University of Auckland will set you apart.
Explore
Don't know what to study?
Try our interactive tool to discover the right programme for you.
Try it now
Need help or advice?
Visit us on campus or connect with our team online to discuss any aspect of your studies and life at uni.
Find out more
Scholarships
Each year we award scholarships and prizes to thousands of students just like you.
Find out more
Entry requirements
Find out about the requirements for entry into a programme of study that interests you.
Find out more
How to apply
Everything you need to know before applying for admission, as well as how to submit your application successfully.
Learn more
Short courses
We offer a wide range of continuing education and short course options, both online and face-to-face.
Find out more
